posts.name: Varun Kumar
posts.cooked:
Hi @sushil1 Sir,

BPT3 was released on Saturday afternoon and its deadline has been fixed as Wednesday. It is too short a timeline and has application of more advanced concepts from week-6 and 7 which is still being absorbed.

Kindly request an extension of timeline for this until next Wednesday for the same as the end term eligibility is also based on these.

Regards,

Varun

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
BPTs are designed to be solved in 2 days. Refer to the grading document:

image713×414 67.1 KB

The deadline of Wednesday already makes it 4+ days.

First few BPTs were extended as they were the first time students were using the VM.

BPT3 Is based on w5 and w6, not on w7.

Regards,
Sayan

posts.name: Varun Kumar
posts.cooked:
Thanks Sayan. First two BPT extension was more due to operational reasons and understanding gap among students regarding BPTs which still exist.

My request is purely to understand the concepts and for trying to solve it. Once the concepts are explained, I can understand 4 days is sufficient. But we are still going through these topics in live sessions; hence the request.
